name: ahk-csv
goal: Ship csv.ahk, the crew's third AutoHotkey v1.1 module: parse a CSV/DSV string into a 1-based array of 1-based row arrays and serialize fields and rows back with correct quoting, exactly per crew/contracts/ahk_csv.md. The module passes the ahk_scan and ahk_api gates (pure functions only: no %, no loose code, no banned words, no hotkeys or labels, no includes) and the hidden TAP tests running AutoHotkey v1.1 inside a disposable Windows Sandbox.

tasks.instructions: Write the whole csv.ahk from scratch against crew/contracts/ahk_csv.md, following the playbook crew/playbooks/ahk_code_task.md. The parser is a character loop over SubStr(text, i, 1) with an inQuotes/afterQuote state machine - NOT Loop, Parse (it strips bare `r data and ignores quoting) and NOT a regex lookahead (the stock library's version needs the banned % idiom). Rules 6-11 state the lenient edge semantics outright: blank lines skipped, trailing line break adds nothing, trailing delimiter is a real empty field, stray mid-field quote is literal, unterminated quoted field swallows the rest of the text as data, bare `r is data, empty text is an empty array. CsvEscape doubles encapsulators BEFORE wrapping and wraps only on delimiter, `r, `n or encapsulator. Read every worked example as a test and walk your code through it (playbook ah-011). No %, no loose code, all three public functions with exactly the contract's spellings and defaults (encap := """").
tasks.test_instructions: Write test_csv.ahk against crew/contracts/ahk_csv.md only, following the playbook crew/playbooks/ahk_code_tests.md. Start with exactly #Include tap.ahk then #Include csv.ahk, end with Done(). Only Is(got, want, name) and Ok(cond, name); every check names its contract rule. Arrays compare by reference: check Length() and then Is() each element (at-004, at-005). Quote literals are doubled (""), line breaks are `n / `r`n, never backslash (at-012). Cover all 16 rules including the stated edge cases: empty text is [] not [""], trailing line break ignored, blank middle line skipped, trailing delimiter keeps an empty field, bare `r is data, quoted CRLF kept exactly, unterminated quote is lenient, stray quote is literal, custom delim/encap, and the round trips Is(CsvParse(CsvRow(fields))[1][k], fields[k], ...). Write at least 16 checks; the reference hidden suite has over 80.
